findings: Lab aux_panic prints UART then infinite sleep; executing on CPU0 foreground would stop that task/core from returning
CPU1 worker panic/fail publishes status7 via established worker mailbox then WFE forever; requires CPU1 restart
CPU0 services architecture requires Rust calls in single-core foreground lwIP loop; blocking panic cannot preserve same-core foreground service
Portable shape recovery requires independent requester withdrawal/abandonment BEFORE recovery and cannot bound blocked MMIO
Codec target panic hook deliberately unresolved; nonreturning Rust panic cannot be converted to normal transaction error by returning from hook
decisions: Do not alias aux_master_panic to lab aux_panic, worker fail, silent loop or a returning stub
Keep existing CPU0 network/CPU1 worker ownership; no unapproved spare-core reassignment
Do not issue target MMIO/UART/log callbacks from unqualified panic handler; they may block or share broken state
Normal packet errors must remain explicit Result/error returns and sticky transaction failure; panic requires separate system fault/recovery contract
Relocatable diagnostic remains valid with unresolved hook; do not claim executable readiness
future_runtime_contract: Choose and verify execution context without stalling CPU0 management or contending with CPU1 worker
If using fault publication, define stable separately owned memory/profile and exact one-shot semantics without target-bus dependencies
Demonstrate independent management can withdraw/abandon unknown outcomes and perform qualified reset; do not fabricate ACK/status success
Qualify panic and hardware exception handling separately from ordinary error paths and host tests
validation: Diagnostic link audit passes, three mutations refused: silent panic binding, unexpected undefined dependency, wrong architecture
limits: Source review + object report audit only, no panic execution or independent recovery proof
next_safe_offline: Inventory ordinary Rust codec panic sites and test bounded valid/invalid input paths to reduce avoidable panic entry; leave system panic hook unresolved until execution context qualified
